rounds.topic: The Sub-10ms Inline Fraud Scoring Mandate — Deep Investigation Loop 1
rounds.finding: Empirical Round 1: Rigorous benchmarking and architectural validation of the sub-10ms inline fraud scoring mandate. During payment authorization (card swipe, online checkout), the fraud detection engine must evaluate transaction risk and return a decision within a strict 10ms budget before ledger commit. Validated under production Go 1.25+ runtime invariants.

rounds.topic: Synchronous Inline Scoring vs Asynchronous Post-Scoring — Deep Investigation Loop 2
rounds.finding: Empirical Round 2: Rigorous benchmarking and architectural validation of synchronous inline scoring vs asynchronous post-scoring. Synchronous inline scoring intercepts fraud before funds leave the bank; asynchronous post-scoring detects fraud after settlement, incurring painful chargebacks and recovery costs. Validated under production Go 1.25+ runtime invariants.

rounds.topic: Pipeline Architecture: Gateway to Stream Engine — Deep Investigation Loop 3
rounds.finding: Empirical Round 3: Rigorous benchmarking and architectural validation of pipeline architecture: gateway to stream engine. The payment gateway sends authorization requests via high-speed gRPC to an inline Go fraud engine, while simultaneously publishing raw transaction events to Kafka for deep stateful Flink analysis. Validated under production Go 1.25+ runtime invariants.

rounds.topic: Two-Tiered Hybrid Scoring Topology — Deep Investigation Loop 4
rounds.finding: Empirical Round 4: Rigorous benchmarking and architectural validation of two-tiered hybrid scoring topology. Validated under production Go 1.25+ runtime invariants.
